Ulthera & Shurink
High-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) lifting · including Liftera and LinearZ

Ultrasound heat reaches the deep layers of the skin, leaving almost no wound on the surface. Redness usually settles within a few hours, and the jawline and cheeks may feel tender or slightly swollen for a few days.
Once the warmth settles, apply to your whole face before heading home.
Don't rub tender areas along the jawline and cheeks; spread it on gently with your palms, pressing lightly.
Apply 30 minutes before going out and reapply every 2–3 hours.
Many clinics advise avoiding facial massage for a while after lifting. Until your clinic says it's okay, spread it on without the rolling massage and rinse right away.
Avoid saunas, alcohol, and strenuous exercise for a few days.
Take a short break from scrubs and peeling products.

In a test where skin was warmed with infrared light, the temperature of the treated cheek dropped by 4.85℃ right after application (Elid Co., Ltd., 22 women). This test was not performed on skin right after a procedure.
Thermage, InMode & Oligio
Radiofrequency (RF) lifting · including Density, TuneFace, and similar devices

These procedures heat the inside of the skin with radiofrequency energy. Redness and a burning sensation usually settle within 2–3 hours, but depending on your skin they can last up to two days. Mild swelling may also occur.
From the day of the procedure in most cases
Apply to your whole face once the warmth has settled.
Some clinics advise washing your face and wearing makeup only from the next day. In that case, cover up with a hat or parasol on the day and start applying the next day.
If your skin feels dry, apply moisturizer first, then layer sunscreen on top.
From the day of the procedure, or when your clinic advises
Some clinics recommend washing with lukewarm water instead of cold water.
So for a few days after the procedure, skip the cleansing milk's ‘cold-water finish’ tip and rinse with lukewarm water.
Don't rub; spread it on lightly and rinse.
Avoid saunas, jjimjilbang (Korean bathhouses), swimming pools, and heavy drinking for about a week.
Take about a week off from peeling treatments and scrubs.
A milk-type cleanser you spread directly onto a dry face, with no need to foam.
The cleansing milk scored 0.00 for skin irritation in a 24-hour patch test and was rated non-irritating (Korea Institute of Dermatological Sciences, 31 participants).
Titanium lifting
Laser lifting
Laser heat reaches the skin's supporting structures. Redness and a burning sensation settle quickly, but tenderness, swelling, and mild bruising may last 1–2 weeks, and skin tends to become dry.
Apply plenty of moisturizing cream, then layer sunscreen on top.
Don't press on bruised or tender areas; lay it on gently.

Wash with lukewarm water.
Many clinics advise avoiding facial meridian massage and other massage for about 2 weeks. During this time, spread it on without the rolling massage and rinse right away.
Avoid alcohol, smoking, saunas, jjimjilbang, and excessive exercise for about a week.
Avoid scrubs, peels, and facial meridian massage for about 2 weeks.
In a usage survey, all 22 respondents said their skin ‘felt moisturized from within’ (right after application, self-assessment).
SPF50+ PA++++; skin irritation score of 0.00 in a 24-hour patch test (Elid Co., Ltd., 34 participants).
ONDA lifting
Microwave lifting
Microwave heat is delivered into the skin. Redness, warmth, and slight swelling may last a few hours, and the treated area may feel tender.
Once the warmth settles, apply a moisturizing cream, then apply sunscreen generously.
Wash gently with lukewarm water.
On tender areas, don't roll; spread it on and rinse right away.
Avoid saunas, jjimjilbang, strenuous exercise, and alcohol for a week.

In a test on skin warmed with infrared light, the temperature of the treated cheek dropped by 4.85℃ right after application (Elid Co., Ltd., 22 women). This test was not performed on skin right after a procedure.
Laser toning
Including pico toning and Genesis
A low-power laser, so there is almost no surface wound. Slight redness and a burning sensation settle within a few hours, and occasionally tiny scabs or dryness may occur.
Toning is often done over several sessions. Daily application between sessions is the basic rule.
Don't rub; spread it on lightly, rinse, and pat dry with a towel.
If tiny scabs form, don't pick them off; let them fall off on their own.
Avoid heavy drinking, saunas, and strenuous exercise.
Space out exfoliation and peels.
A triple-function sunscreen for UV protection, brightening, and anti-wrinkle care (niacinamide, adenosine).
Some clinics advise taking a break from brightening and anti-wrinkle functional cosmetics right after the procedure. If you were given that advice, follow your clinic during that period.

Apply thoroughly, including over darkened blemishes.

Vascular lasers
Redness lasers · Vbeam, Excel V, and more
Redness may temporarily deepen with slight swelling (a few hours to 1–2 days). In some cases purple bruising may appear and last from a few days to about 2 weeks.
Don't rub bruised areas; pat it on with your fingertips.
Skin treated with a laser may be sensitive to sunlight for a while, so the habit of applying every day matters.
Use lukewarm water instead of hot water.
Spread it on lightly without the rolling massage and rinse.
If scabs form, leave them alone; don't pick them off.
Avoid saunas, heavy drinking, and exercise that makes you sweat a lot for a few days.
